summary: Single stage planetary gearbox: sun gear keyed on the input shaft drives three planet gears on bearings and pins fixed in a carrier keyed on the output shaft. Planets mesh with an internal ring gear fixed in a split housing with a cover. Input and output shafts each run on two housing bearings under

subassemblies.name: Housing
subassemblies.description: The housing that carries the bearings, with its cover and bearing caps.

parts.name: Planet gear
parts.description: Case hardened steel spur gear, module 2, 30 teeth, 20 mm face width, 42 mm H7 bore.

parts.name: Ring gear
parts.description: Through hardened steel spur gear, module 2, 90 teeth, 20 mm face width.

parts.name: Housing base
parts.description: Lower half of the split housing: mounting feet, the bearing bores for every shaft and the flange the cover bolts to, Cast iron.

parts.name: Housing cover
parts.description: Upper half of the split housing (the cover), bolted to the base, Cast iron.

parts.name: Input open cap
parts.description: Open flanged bearing cap: the shaft passes through it, Cast iron.

parts.name: Output open cap
parts.description: Open flanged bearing cap: the shaft passes through it, Cast iron.

parts.name: Cap screw
parts.description: Socket head cap screw M6x16 that fixes the bearing caps.

parts.name: Cover bolt
parts.description: Hex bolt M8x30 joining the cover to the base.

subassemblies.name: Input shaft group
subassemblies.description: The input shaft with what it carries, assembled as one unit.

parts.name: Input shaft
parts.description: 42CrMo4 steel shaft Ø20 x 87, with a DIN 6885 keyseat for its gear.

parts.name: Sun gear
parts.description: Case hardened steel spur gear, module 2, 30 teeth, 20 mm face width, 20 mm H7 bore with a keyway per DIN 6885.

parts.name: Sun gear key
parts.description: Parallel key DIN 6885 form A 6 x 6 x 18 mm, locks the Sun gear to the Input shaft.

subassemblies.name: Output shaft group
subassemblies.description: The output shaft with what it carries, assembled as one unit.

parts.name: Output shaft
parts.description: 42CrMo4 steel shaft Ø20 x 84, with a DIN 6885 keyseat for its hub.

parts.name: Carrier key
parts.description: Parallel key DIN 6885 form A 6 x 6 mm, locks the Planet carrier to the Output shaft.

subassemblies.name: Planet pin group
subassemblies.description: The planet pin with what it carries, assembled as one unit.
